Check  here why you lie to me?? Rork need to be honest FINAL IVX ACCOUNT RECOVERY + BIOMETRIC SECURITY

Complete account recovery and biometric login for:

- Owner
- Admin
- Member
- Investor
- Buyer
- JV Partner
- Tokenized Investor
- Broker
- Agent
- Land Owner

==================================================
1. RECOVERY METHODS
==================================================

Support:

- verified email reset
- verified phone OTP
- recovery codes
- trusted-device recovery
- MFA recovery
- manual compliance review for high-risk accounts

Do not use security questions.

Never reveal whether an unknown email has an account.

Use:

“If an account exists, recovery instructions have been sent.”

==================================================
2. PASSWORD RESET
==================================================

Required flow:

FORGOT PASSWORD
→ GENERIC RESPONSE
→ SES EMAIL
→ SECURE ONE-TIME LINK
→ RECOVERY SESSION
→ NEW PASSWORD
→ OLD SESSIONS REVOKED
→ OLD PASSWORD REJECTED
→ NEW PASSWORD ACCEPTED
→ SECURITY NOTIFICATION

Requirements:

- short expiration
- single use
- replay prevention
- correct mobile/web callback
- rate limiting
- audit event
- trace ID

==================================================
3. LOST EMAIL OR PHONE
==================================================

For lost recovery-channel access:

LOW-RISK MEMBER:
- recovery code or trusted device
- verified secondary channel
- manual review when neither exists

FINANCIAL USER:
- identity/KYC match
- government ID where approved
- trusted-device evidence
- manual compliance review
- mandatory waiting period
- notification to old contact channels
- revoke all sessions after approval

OWNER:
- owner recovery code
- verified hardware/trusted device
- manual emergency procedure
- dual approval where configured
- full audit trail

No support agent may directly replace the email and issue access without
the approved recovery workflow.

==================================================
4. BIOMETRIC LOGIN
==================================================

Implement:

IOS:
- LocalAuthentication
- Face ID
- Touch ID
- Keychain/Secure Enclave

ANDROID:
- BiometricPrompt
- fingerprint
- supported secure face authentication
- Android Keystore

Biometric data must remain inside the operating system.

IVX receives only:

SUCCESS
FAILED
CANCELLED
LOCKED_OUT
NOT_AVAILABLE
NOT_ENROLLED

Never store:

- face image
- fingerprint image
- biometric template
- biometric scan
- raw biometric data

==================================================
5. BIOMETRIC ENROLLMENT
==================================================

Enable only after successful normal sign-in.

Flow:

NORMAL LOGIN
→ VALID SESSION
→ USER OPT-IN
→ SYSTEM BIOMETRIC PROMPT
→ GENERATE DEVICE-BOUND KEY
→ PROTECT SESSION/REFRESH CREDENTIAL
→ SAVE DEVICE REGISTRATION
→ CONFIRM ENABLED

Show:

“Use Face ID”
“Use Fingerprint”
“Use device security”

Allow disable from Settings.

==================================================
6. BIOMETRIC SESSION RULES
==================================================

Biometric unlock may unlock a securely stored existing session.

It must not:

- create a new account
- bypass revoked sessions
- bypass server authorization
- bypass KYC
- bypass investment eligibility
- bypass owner-role checks
- reveal the password
- replace password recovery

After biometric success:

1. Unlock device-bound credential.
2. Call Supabase/server session validation.
3. Refresh session if valid.
4. Load roles from server.
5. Route to correct dashboard.

If session is revoked or invalid:
Require normal sign-in.

==================================================
7. STEP-UP AUTHENTICATION
==================================================

Require fresh authentication for:

- changing password
- changing email
- changing phone
- adding/removing bank account
- enabling payments
- investment confirmation
- withdrawal
- refund
- ownership changes
- owner/admin actions
- viewing sensitive documents
- disabling MFA
- generating recovery codes

Step-up options:

- recent password
- biometric plus valid server session
- TOTP/authenticator
- verified OTP
- passkey where implemented

For high-risk financial actions, require at least two independent controls.

==================================================
8. DEVICE MANAGEMENT
==================================================

Create an Authentication & Devices page.

Display:

DEVICE ID
DEVICE NAME
PLATFORM
OS VERSION
APP VERSION
FIRST SEEN
LAST SEEN
LAST IP
APPROXIMATE LOCATION
LOGIN METHOD
BIOMETRIC ENABLED
TRUSTED STATUS
SESSION STATUS
LAST REFRESH
RISK STATUS

Actions:

- rename device
- trust device
- revoke device
- revoke all devices
- disable biometric
- require password next login
- report unknown device

==================================================
9. BIOMETRIC INVALIDATION
==================================================

Automatically invalidate biometric unlock after:

- password reset
- email recovery
- phone recovery
- owner-role change
- account lock
- session revocation
- device removed
- biometric enrollment changed
- secure key invalidated
- app reinstall
- suspicious login
- too many failed attempts

Require normal password/MFA login to re-enable.

==================================================
10. ACCOUNT LOCK AND RECOVERY STATES
==================================================

Use:

ACTIVE
EMAIL_VERIFICATION_PENDING
PHONE_VERIFICATION_PENDING
RECOVERY_PENDING
MANUAL_REVIEW
TEMPORARILY_LOCKED
SECURITY_LOCKED
SUSPENDED
RECOVERED
CLOSED

Do not delete financial identities during recovery.

Preserve:

- investments
- payments
- documents
- messages
- offers
- ownership
- audit history

==================================================
11. OWNER SECURITY CONTROLS
==================================================

Owner dashboard must support:

- view security incidents
- lock account
- require password reset
- require MFA enrollment
- revoke device
- revoke all sessions
- approve/deny manual recovery
- view recovery evidence
- view recovery timeline
- see who approved recovery
- export audit history

The owner must never see:

- password
- password hash
- OTP
- recovery-code plaintext
- biometric data
- full tokens

==================================================
12. RECOVERY CODES
==================================================

Generate one-time recovery codes.

Requirements:

- display once
- hash before storage
- downloadable/printable
- one use per code
- regenerate invalidates old codes
- audit usage
- notify user when used

Owner should keep codes offline.

==================================================
13. SECURITY NOTIFICATIONS
==================================================

Notify user for:

- new login
- new device
- biometric enabled
- biometric disabled
- password changed
- email changed
- phone changed
- recovery requested
- recovery completed
- recovery rejected
- MFA changed
- device revoked
- suspicious login

Send through verified email and in-app notifications.

==================================================
14. TEST MATRIX
==================================================

Test:

[ ] Face ID success
[ ] Face ID failure
[ ] Touch ID success
[ ] Fingerprint success
[ ] Biometric cancelled
[ ] Biometric lockout
[ ] No biometric enrolled
[ ] Device PIN fallback
[ ] Session valid
[ ] Session expired
[ ] Session revoked
[ ] App restart
[ ] App reinstall
[ ] Password reset invalidates biometric
[ ] Email recovery invalidates biometric
[ ] Device revocation
[ ] New biometric enrollment invalidates key
[ ] Recovery code success
[ ] Recovery code replay rejected
[ ] Lost email manual review
[ ] Lost phone manual review
[ ] Owner emergency recovery
[ ] Non-owner cannot approve recovery
[ ] Financial action requires step-up auth

==================================================
15. FINAL PROOF
==================================================

Return:

EMAIL RECOVERY:
PHONE RECOVERY:
RECOVERY CODES:
MANUAL REVIEW:
OWNER RECOVERY:

IOS FACE ID:
IOS TOUCH ID:
ANDROID FINGERPRINT:
ANDROID FACE:
DEVICE PIN FALLBACK:

DEVICE MANAGEMENT:
SESSION REVOCATION:
BIOMETRIC INVALIDATION:
STEP-UP AUTH:
SECURITY NOTIFICATIONS:
AUDIT LEDGER:

PHYSICAL ANDROID:
PHYSICAL IOS:

GITHUB SHA:
RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
RUNTIME SHA:
APK VERSION:
IOS BUILD:
TRACE IDS:
SCREENSHOTS:

FINAL VERDICT:
VERIFIED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / FAILED

Do not mark VERIFIED unless biometric login is tested on a physical device,
password recovery works through real email delivery, revoked sessions are
blocked, and account recovery cannot bypass role or financial security.
